verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering legal services, including a formation partnership with Clerky. It is not an AI agent or software client that could consume MCP server tools, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
